title: OnCo: a public, cited knowledge graph of oncology
description: OnCo maps the war on cancer as a linked corpus: cancers, technologies, targets, products, companies, institutions, people, pathways, trials, pairings, roadmaps, key papers, journals, bottlenecks and ideas, one record per object with a plain-English TL;DR, a technical summary, dated facts and sources. Each release archives the corpus as JSON (per entity and per kind), NDJSON, CSV, a JSON Schema and an OpenAPI description, exactly as published under https://onco.cc/api/v1/. Code is MIT. Data are CC BY-NC 4.0: free for individual and educational use with attribution ("Data from OnCo (onco.cc)"); commercial use must contact OnCo to pay for the data. Nothing in the dataset is medical advice.
notes: Facts are being built and checked in the open and may be incomplete, out of date or wrong; verify at the primary source before relying on them. Nothing in this dataset is medical advice.
